model.weights_provenance: general Ultralytics COCO pretrained YOLOv8s; not custom-trained
model.class_mapping_note: Resolved from model.names. Recognised person aliases map to person; car/motorcycle/bus/truck/van/vehicle aliases merge to vehicle.

matched_iou.definition: IoU values of confidence-ordered, one-to-one, class-matched true positives at the AP IoU threshold
